meta.title: Antigravity Executor
meta.description: Delegate coding tasks to the signed-in Antigravity desktop agent and watch every turn live in a War Room dashboard. The dashboard has two entry points: the dsh sidebar panel icon, and the standalone page on http://127.0.0.1:18420 — both are the exact same page (same-origin embedded, not two separate implementations), with the in-app panel rendering that very page through dsh's same-origin proxy, so both show identical DOM, features, and follow the host's light/dark theme. It provides a five-stage lifecycle stepper, a streaming tool-call timeline with four verdict badges (Clean, Hanging, Escape, Blocked Destructive), dual-window account quota gauges (5h + weekly) with reset countdowns and reserve marker lines, one-click emergency abort and cooldown skip, hot runtime policy switches, session management with eviction, brain artifact browsing, and a live HTML/3D preview split pane that refreshes when a turn settles. The console is served by a zero-dependency node:http + SSE server that frees its port on reload. It also retains the adaptive surgical/creative task mode with a Pass-1 visual gate, RPC settlement returning within seconds, an in-process serial queue, untruncated long reports, dual-window 5h/weekly quota guards with a 24h floor, split destructive-vs-escape circuit breakers, human-like inter-turn pacing, dead-session self-heal, a 60s hanging-command circuit breaker, and git snapshots inlined into every result.
